_note: Historical provenance for the 13 perf_bench_*.jsonl files in this directory. Written 2026-09-24 in response to JOSS review follow-up (@gmarupilla, openjournals/joss-reviews#11034): reviewers doing third-party re-aggregation want the exact source commit and environment for the runs. Retroactive package pinning is best-effort — the runs themselves did not capture pip freeze; future runs will, per the enhanced _machine_fingerprint() in perf_bench.py.

source_commit.subject: perf benchmark harness + docs/performance page (JOSS @betolink Performance checkbox) (#27)
source_commit.note: This is the commit that introduced smoke-tests/perf_bench.py and its aggregator. Runs happened 2026-09-03 19:55 UTC through 21:11 UTC, spanning ~2 hours around this merge. Fetch-code paths that time the runs exercise (fetch_data.py:_fetch_via_stac and _direct_fetch._fetch_via_direct_http) were not changed between 2026-08-20 and 2026-09-16, so `git checkout 8a4a2e3` reproduces the code that produced these numbers.

runs.note: First run; three configs mis-declared (S1-RTC bands lowercased, 3DEP-seamless vs 3DEP, Landsat time range) -- fixed in the -retry-* files.

laptop-cellular.packages_note: Pip freeze not captured at run time. The conda env was created via the recommended mamba recipe in README.md at commit 8a4a2e3, so rasterio/pystac/planetary-computer/etc. are the conda-forge versions current on 2026-09-03. Reproduce by fresh `mamba create` from that README revision. Future runs of perf_bench.py capture these versions in the JSONL header directly.

reproduce.install: mamba env create from the README mamba recipe at that commit
reproduce.run: python smoke-tests/perf_bench.py --configs credfree --label mylaptop  # or SLURM equivalent from perf_bench.slurm
reproduce.expected: Table arithmetic matches docs/performance.qmd within displayed precision when the same 3 runs per config are aggregated; absolute wall times will differ per machine + network.
